question: Rem was erased by the Authority of Gluttony, so everyone’s memories except Subaru’s were rewritten (?) such that the disturbance at the village was somehow taken care of by Subaru and Ram, and along those lines, all matters were resolved without Rem, but even in the case of someone who liked Rem so much that their love of her was reflected in their way of life and personality, would they also have their understanding completely rewritten? answer: Even if you fill in the blanks bored into your memory, the feelings that you directed towards someone will be directed towards someone similar… I like to think that wouldn’t happen. Just as it looks, Garf has liked Ram from the beginning, you know.
